lines.text: Single season, single shot, and the Showdown is settled!
No second chances in a Showdown this short, and {winnerClub} made the first count!
Over before the kettle cools, and the Showdown has its champion!
They had a single season to settle it, and {winner} did exactly that.
Settled in a flash! {winnerClub} comes through ahead of {loserClub}!
Short, sharp, and then the silence before the verdict: the Showdown has a winner!
Clean run, steady nerve, and {winner} never looked back.
This Showdown never hung about, and neither did {winnerClub}!
Nowhere to hide in a race this short, and nobody hid.
Quick as a whistle, it is decided, and {winnerClub} holds the prize!
Winner takes everything, {winner}, and everything is yours!
Run in a single breath, and {winnerClub} breathed best!
No slow burn here, just a season of pure nerve, and it pays off!
Blink and you would have missed it, but the Showdown is done!
Everything on the line, nothing held in reserve, and {winnerClub} comes out on top!
{loser} gave it everything, but this one belongs to {winner}.
Settled at once, just as promised, and the result is in!
Imagine the nerve it takes to decide it all inside a season.
Straight to the point, {winner}, and straight to the title!
A single page of the story, and the whole ending is already written!
When the stakes are this short, every minute counts, and every one was used.
Done before the second thought, and what a finish!
{winnerClub} did not need a long haul to prove the point, only a good start and a better finish.
There is no tomorrow in a Showdown like this, and the winner made the most of it.
Beaten by {margin}, {loser} can hold a head high, but the Showdown is {winner}'s.
Brief Showdowns deserve brief celebrations, and {winner} has earned a loud one!
It all came down to this, and {winner} came down on the right side.
Clean, crisp, decisive, and the Showdown is done!
Start fast, finish faster, and you win a race like this. Well done.
No time to catch a breath, but plenty to celebrate.
Short but never small, this Showdown, and it will be remembered.
The laurels go to the winner, and the rest of the table can only applaud.
{loserClub} threw everything into it, but this one goes to {winnerClub}.
Think of the nerves at the start, and then of the calm at the finish.
All that preparation, all that waiting, and the knockout lands in a single season!
Straight off the mark and straight into the cabinet, {winnerClub}!
Over the line first, and the Showdown has its champion!
The whole thing, settled and sealed within a season.
Well, that was brisk! {winnerClub} takes the Showdown with {winnerPoints} on the board!
In and out, job done, and the winner walks away with the lot.
Nobody would have bet on a verdict this fast, but here it is, clean and clear.
Fast, fierce and final, and the Showdown goes to {winnerClub}!
Hats off to {loser}, who pushed hard, but the prize belongs to {winner}.
{winner} did not need a decade, only a great season.
The smallest stage with the biggest prize, and it has been claimed!
Short story, strong ending, and a very worthy author.
Both put everything into the season, and {winnerClub} put in a little more.
Done and dusted! {winner} takes it by {margin} and the title with it!
Not a Showdown for the faint-hearted, and {winner} has the nerve to prove it.
If you want a Showdown settled in a hurry, {winnerClub} is your club.
Beautifully brisk, this one, and beautifully won!
The ink is barely dry on the season, and the crown is already placed.
Hold the front page, because {winner} has won the lot!
Speed, nerve and a great season: the winner had all three.
Season of graft, moment of glory, and {winnerClub} gets to keep it.
{loser} took a fine run at it, but {winner} had the finish.
Sudden, spectacular and entirely settled, and the Showdown has its answer!
Every second mattered, and every second was used!
That is how you tell a short story: a sharp start, a perfect ending, and no wasted words.
It took a season, and {winnerClub} has taken the Showdown!
Well driven, {winner}. The rest were left looking at your tail lights.
Tape is broken, the race is won, and one manager stands alone at the front.
Settled with a flourish, and {winnerClub} is the name on the prize!
Lightning does not strike twice, and {winner} only needed it once!
Decisive season, decisive winner, and the Showdown is {winner}'s!
Not a moment to waste, and {winnerClub} did not waste any.
Rapid, ruthless and rather lovely, this win, with a champion's calm throughout.
Shortest road to a Showdown title has just one traveler at the end.
Whatever it takes to win in a hurry, {winner} had it in abundance.
After a finish like that, the winner needs a sit down, and has earned it.
{winnerClub} on the top step and {loserClub} close behind, as the curtain comes down.
You blink, you miss it, and the winner did not blink.
Plenty of drama in a season, and {winner} gets the last laugh!
Spare a thought for {loser}, who started fast, but {winner} finished it.
What a whirlwind, and what a calm in the eye of it!
Decided inside a season, and the verdict is clear.
Never mind the long game, because the short one has been won!
With {winnerPoints} on the board, {winnerClub} pulls clear of {loserClub} and into glory!
Clinical, composed and crowned, that is {winner} right now.
There is joy in a short Showdown, and the winner has found all of it!
Everyone wanted a quick answer, and the quick answer has come.
From the first day of the season to the last, {winnerClub} was simply the better side.
A season is a short time to build a legend, but it has been done.
Gold in a heartbeat for {winner}, and no regrets!
Good race, {loser}, but {winner} just got there first.
Swift, sure and sensational: this Showdown is {winnerClub}'s!
A whole Showdown wrapped up, and {winner} already has the trophy home.
Finish line reached, winner clear, and it is as simple as that.
A short fuse, a big bang, and the Showdown lights up!
Crisp as a cold morning, this win by {winner}!
They said nobody could settle it that fast, and {winner} went right ahead and did.
Over in a single stroke, and the pen is in the winner's hand!
Every word of this story has a clear author, and the pen was {winner}'s.
Pocket this one, {winner}, because a quick win is still a win!
Hello and goodbye, and what a brilliant guest {winnerClub} turned out to be!
Won by {margin}, and a warm handshake across the table for {loser}.
Shortest chapter in the book, and the winner owns every line of it.
Quick off the line, quicker to the finish, and {winnerClub} has the Showdown!
Fast finish, fast season, fast title, and {winnerClub} crosses first!
Cabinet door swinging open already, {winner}, because this Showdown is yours.
